# Career Writing Instruction

Read and apply [packs/shared/writing-style.md](../../packs/shared/writing-style.md) for every career document.

Keep the candidate's seniority and discipline history precise. Separate the contractual role from project roles, and never convert total professional experience into years of Data Engineering when earlier work was in another field.

Write fluent, human prose. Use concrete verbs, vary sentence openings, keep one primary idea per bullet, and avoid repetitive qualifiers such as "approximately". Put ATS keywords in the skills section instead of forcing them into every sentence.

Before rendering, perform a final pass for unsupported claims, repeated words, choppy transitions, confidential project details, and numbers that were made more precise than their source.
